explication: Godot MCP exposes Godot project and editor operations as tools to an MCP-compatible AI client. The client requests a tool; the server either runs a direct Godot CLI command or delegates complex scene/resource work to the bundled GDScript operations script. Project discovery and analysis, runtime control and diagnostics, scene editing, and UID management are distinct capabilities. The README documents these branches; the sampled TypeScript excerpts do not show every handler implementation or its exact command wiring.
